_comment: Pause menu > Tips pages for the mod (read by tools/merge_tips.py, NOT a monster tip table). Each topic becomes one or more pages of 7 lines: header (on the tab, max 8 capitals), subtitle (next to the tab, keep it short), paragraphs. *word* = highlight colour; a paragraph starting with '- ' is a bullet; a number and its unit (0.8 s, 70 px) never split. Pages break between paragraphs where they can. god = the deity name for god topics (pages for the gods in the current game come first). Only characters every HUD font has; no square brackets.

topics.subtitle: the Frost Widow
text: *Blizzard* (god perk): while Ysveld monsters fight, blizzards sweep the room and lay *ice paths*.
- The *hero* slides on ice. *Ysveld monsters* run faster on it.
- A dying Ysveld monster leaves a patch of ice. *The Pale Empress* brings blizzards more often.
*Rime:* frost hits fill *frost pips* over the hero. Three pips *pin* him in ice for a moment.

topics.subtitle: the Storm Forge
text: *Lightning arcs* (god perk): crackling arcs join nearby Kaurn monsters and iron rods. Crossing one *zaps* the hero.
*Rods:* a Kaurn monster leaves an iron rod where it dies. Rods from attacks are arc posts too.
*Static sparks:* basic attacks store sparks. The *special* fires them all at the hero.
*Static Build:* when your hair stands on end, stand by a rod: it takes the bolt.

topics.subtitle: the Brood Queen
text: *Larvae* (god perk): a dying Zhekra monster hatches a weak, fast *Hive Larva*.
*Swarm:* a Zhekra monster near any other monster *swarms*: faster and fiercer.
*Mark:* an amber chevron over the hero. Every Zhekra near him swarms.
*Acid:* a green tint on the hero. He takes *more damage*.
*Resin* roots the hero. *Frenzy:* the Brood Mother speeds up every monster near her.

topics.subtitle: the Drowned Bell
text: *Rising Tide* (god perk): while Bel'Mora monsters fight, the tide leaves *brine pools*. Bel'Mora monsters also spill brine where they die.
- Brine *slows the hero*.
- *Bel'Mora monsters* in brine *heal*.
*Hooks and currents* haul the hero in. Cross a current sideways.

topics.subtitle: the Hollow Mirror
text: *Echoes* (god perk): every Umbrael basic attack *repeats a beat later* in the same spot. Dodge, then dodge again.
*Darkness* hides Umbrael monsters. When *the Unblinking* opens its eye, stand still.

topics.subtitle: the Marrow King
text: *Bone piles* (god perk): an Ossivar monster leaves bones where it dies. They *crawl* to the nearest Ossivar and become a *plate* that blocks a hit.
*Bleeding* draws Marrow Hounds, Gravetusks and Cairn Crows to you.
*Rattlebones:* while its skull lies on the floor, only the skull can be hurt.
*Church Grim* falls into bones once. Stand on the pile or it gets up.

topics.subtitle: the Rot Orchard
text: *Seeds* (god perk): a dying Sylvene monster drops a seed that ripens into a *pod*. A ripe pod bursts with *poison* when you come close.
*Grafted pods* ride on monsters' heads. *Cordyceps* make the dead fight on.

topics.subtitle: the Tallow Saint
text: *Pyres* (god perk): a Vhorrul monster burns where it dies, then cools into a *tallow slick*.
*Wax* slows you. *Fire lights wax*. Tallow monsters *heal* in unlit wax.
*Lantern Wraith* steals your soul flame. Step into fire to take it back.

topics.subtitle: the Grinning Jester
text: *Wild Card* (god perk): each special flips a card over the monster: *Hearts* heal, *Spades* hit harder, *Diamonds* block a hit, *Clubs* run faster.
*Chance:* cards and dice curse or hurt at random. Every Jinx monster has a trick of its own.

topics.subtitle: mod status effects
text: Mod crowd control is short:
- *Slow:* sludge at the feet.
- *Root:* roots grip the feet. Can still attack.
- *Stun:* stars over the head.
After a chain of these the target is *immune* for a while.
*Plates* (bone, shell, wax, ice, resin, card...) each block one hero hit.

topics.subtitle: the ten ghost forms
text: *Wisp* is the normal ghost. Every form takes a body the usual way.
*Poltergeist:* throws hex bolts. *Gleaner:* draws ectoplasm to you.
*Binder:* spawns Gels and fuses them into bigger blobs.
*Banshee:* wails to slow the hero. *Sexton:* digs graves that raise Revenants.
*Kindler:* lights Fusebelly bombs. *Mason:* stone turrets spit on command.
*Hexer:* hexed heroes take more damage. *Miser:* spends stored bodies on one big Mimic.
*Silver:* your monsters drop orbs. Eight send your next body up a tier.
*Gold:* jump out of a body and it fights on for you in gold.
Under the forms, pick the *blob* Back spawns. Each form starts on its own. The *King Blob* is for silver and gold only.

topics.subtitle: silver and gold
text: The *silver* and *gold* slots sit last on the god, origin and ghost lists. A challenge opens each.
- *Idols:* pick a god's *perk* and starters from any god (three for silver, four for gold).
- *Heroes:* pick your look and weapon (gold adds a spell). Every pick costs stats.
- *Ghosts:* your own look. Silver *Ascends*, gold makes *Thralls*.
Your picks are saved for your player slot.

topics.subtitle: opening the slots
text: Progress counts in every game you play (bots do not count) and is kept between games. A locked slot shows its count.
- *Silver origin*: kill *400* monsters as the hero.
- *Gold origin*: win *5* games as the hero.
- *Silver idol*: evolve your monsters *60* times.
- *Gold idol*: evolve *20* different final forms.
- *Silver ghost*: gather *1000* ectoplasm as a ghost.
- *Gold ghost*: slay the hero *40* times as a monster.
- *Blobs*: spawn *100* Motes as the Gleaner, hit the hero with Spitter goo *60* times, fuse *8* Titans as the Binder.
A banner on the next menu tells you when a slot opens.

topics.subtitle: what the little markers mean
text: Markers over the head:
- *Shields:* plates left.
- *Lightning bolts:* stored Kaurn sparks.
- *Ice crystals:* frost pips.
- *Red double chevron:* more damage.
At the feet: *green sparkles* heal, *white streaks* mean faster, a *blue skid* means ice.

topics.subtitle: the mod's two bosses
text: *The Leviathan* (Bel'Mora): tides wash the arena. Its heads jet brine, hook the hero and spit.
*Pandemonium* (Jinx): its Wheel of Misfortune drops knives, bombs and Jack-in-the-Boxes. Its tentacles juggle and throw dice; its eye sweeps a golden beam.

topics.subtitle: new potions and trinkets
text: *Potions* change stats for good. Some have a short catch, shown on the hero.
*Trinket markers:* a *linen roll* is the Bandage, a *red crosshair* is the Wanted mark, a *coin* is the Gambler's flip.
Two trinkets are never sold. The first hides behind a cracked wall.

topics.subtitle: new traps and shrines
text: *Ghost traps:* step a ghost in, aim with movement, attack to fire. Each shows its tip the first time.
*On the floor:* *Iron Snares* bite and hold. *Warp Stones* come in pairs.
*For the hero* (outside fights): *Mending Spring* heals, *Weapon Rack* swaps your weapon, *Ward Shrine* softens hits, *Cursed Altar* trades safety for damage, *Strongboxes* hold gold, or a mimic.
*Spirit Urn:* a ghost smashes it for ectoplasm.

topics.subtitle: party, games and secrets
text: *Jukebox:* changes the music for the floor.
*Disco Ball:* stand on lit tiles to the beat for *Disco Fever*.
*Confetti Cannon:* dazes all in front, then everyone runs faster.
*Pinata:* hit it for gold. *Bounce Shroom:* a springy jump. *Firework Crate:* light it and stand back.
*Games of chance:* the *Slot Machine*, the *Fortune Teller* and the *Wishing Well* pay out gold, health or ectoplasm.
*Secrets:* some objects keep a secret. The vault holds a riddle for each.

topics.subtitle: secret statues
text: Now and then a statue room holds a *secret statue* with a *gold seam* on its plinth. Only a ghost can wake it.
- *Grotesque:* turns to stone and throws hits back.
- *Sixfold Idol:* a random weapon every swing.
- *Gambit:* leaps like a chess knight.
- *Caryatid:* raises marble columns.
- *Lachrymosa (legendary):* stone while watched, swift unseen. She puts out the lights.
